title: Nonpositive cosine on a centered period
statement: For every real number $\theta$ with $-\pi<\theta<\pi$, one has $\cos\theta\le0$ if and only if $\theta\le-\pi/2$ or $\pi/2\le\theta$.
replaced: For every real $\theta$ with $-\pi<\theta<\pi$, $\cos\theta\le0$ if and only if $\theta\le-\pi/2$ or $\pi/2\le\theta$.
